page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a brace-marked list in the lower half with its label "Nomina in plur. num. definentia in" to the left of the braces; a second brace-marked list below with its label "Nom. prop. mulierum singul. num. desinunt in" to the left. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: Excipiuntur tamen ea, quæ in numero multitudinis duplicem habent finem, in, I, scilicet, ac generis sunt virilis, & in A, quomodo genus mutant ex virili in muliebre: quæ omnia subiecto typo ob oculos ponuntur.
main_text.l: Nomina in plur. num. definentia in
A, Dita, Lábbra & Lábbia, Ginócchia, Bráccia, Légna vestígia, Rísa, &c.
I, Díti, Lábbri, Ginócchi, Brácci, Légni, Vestigii, Rísi.
main_text.p: Sed quæ desinunt in A, magis ac frequentius vsurpant, qui versantur in soluta oratione.
Porrò & nomina muliebris generis haud eodem modo finiunt, vt subiecti typi ostendunt.
main_text.l: Nom. prop. mulierum singul. num. desinunt in
A, Cornélia, Láura, Túllia, Lucrétia, María, &c.
O, Glicério, Calísto, Dido, Sáfo, Calípso, Ino, &c.

page.notes: Braces in the original are not reproduced; list lines follow the printed order. Some letters in the brace lists are uncertain in the scan (e.g. "Lábbri'" and "Ginócchi").
